## 用git连接github
先在本地仓库目录下启动cmd或者git bash
创建连接信息
``` bash
git config --global user.name "DimMeteor"
git config --global user.email "1592497663@qq.com"
```
建立远程链接
``` bash
git remote add origin git@github.com:DimMeteor/Dim-blog
```
修改远程链接仓库
``` bash
git remote set-url origin git@github.com:DimMeteor/Dim-blog.git
```
将仓库内容全部推入暂存区
``` bash
git add *
```
将嵌套仓库(引用了别的仓库)添加暂存权限(需重新推入)
``` bash
git submodule add https://github.com/D-Sketon/hexo-theme-reimu.git themes/reimu
```
将暂存区内容提交到header
``` bash
git commit -m "代码提交信息"
```
将暂存区内容提交到仓库
``` bash
git push origin master
```

title: Hello World
content:
Welcome to [Hexo](https://hexo.io/)! This is your very first post. Check [documentation](https://hexo.io/docs/) for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in [troubleshooting](https://hexo.io/docs/troubleshooting.html) or you can ask me on [GitHub](https://github.com/hexojs/hexo/issues).

## Quick Start

### Create a new post

``` bash
$ hexo new "My New Post"
```

More info: [Writing](https://hexo.io/docs/writing.html)

### Run server

``` bash
$ hexo server
```

More info: [Server](https://hexo.io/docs/server.html)

### Generate static files

``` bash
$ hexo generate
```

More info: [Generating](https://hexo.io/docs/generating.html)

### Deploy to remote sites

``` bash
$ hexo deploy
```

More info: [Deployment](https://hexo.io/docs/one-command-deployment.html)
